items.sentence: Today, the two kittens have similar stripes on their soft backs.
Today, the rainy situation changed all the plans for the picnic.
Today, these two puzzles are related because they share one picture.
Readers suppose the door opened because muddy prints lead outside.
Students learn social rules by taking turns during group work.
Today, every snowflake has a unique shape falling from the sky.
Today, some penguins prefer cold water to warm sunny beaches.
Three apples remain within the basket after the long picnic.
One buzzing bee can distract the artist from her painting.
Today, the quiet garden district has flowers along every narrow street.
